Morning assembly. Soon after taking up her 
post, Acting Principal Kashimoto speaks 
about the current "laxity" of the academy.

She also advocates a "Managed Education 
Program" that strictly regulates 
everything from training to dietary 
intake.

Furthermore, stating that the Aoharu Cup 
team races risked causing a collective 
teenage frenzy, they announced plans for 
its abolition.

A torrent of boos erupted. Taiki Shuttle 
also opposed the overly strict policy, but 
was talked down by Acting Director 
Kashimoto.
